brief:
UN human rights chief Volker Türk has raised "serious concerns of ethnic cleansing" over Israeli threats to empty neighborhoods in Hebron, Middle East Eye reported. Türk's warning addresses Israeli actions targeting Palestinian residential areas in the occupied West Bank city.

The statement reflects escalating international concern over displacement policies affecting Palestinian communities in Hebron, a city with a significant Israeli settler presence and a large Palestinian population.
dek: UN human rights chief warns of 'ethnic cleansing' in Hebron UN human rights chief Volker Turk said Israeli threats to empty neighbourhoods in Hebron raise "serious concerns of ethnic cleansing".
title: UN warns Israel of ethnic cleansing in Hebron
